name: crt-egl
notes: Added 2026-10-11 for Web Tranche 3B milestone B3. The Khronos EGL-Registry headers (EGL, KHR; Apache-2.0/MIT per file; a pinned main-branch commit because the registry publishes no releases, archive checksum of the GitHub-generated tarball not independently verified) plus the CRT-owned 'no GPU' libEGL.so and libGLESv2.so (libcrtweb/platform/gles-stub). WebCore links OpenGL::GLES and EGL unconditionally and libwpe's CMake requires an EGL library, but the CRT port paints on the CPU until Tranche 9; the libraries answer every call with failure, so a context is never created. Not a host library: it is built from CRT source with the CRT toolchain.
macOS (2026-10-12 replay): ELF-only link flags are per-host overrides, test link lines name .dylib, and tests of shared libraries use the shared C runtime.

macOS: the test (and any consumer of eglplatform.h) defines __unix__: eglplatform.h selects native types from __unix__/__APPLE__, and the CRT macOS persona (-U__APPLE__, -D__linux__=1 for ports) defines neither. Real Linux clang defines both __linux__ and __unix__.
